A '''ground support wing''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Organization==
A ground support wing was the result of a compromise between the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] and the Army. The Army wanted their own dedicated [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] support, while the Navy wanted to retain control of the fighters. The resulting unit consisted of only forty [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] starfighters, rather than the seventy-two of the standard naval wing. Numbering forty TIEs, they were split into ten flights of four fighters each. Three flights were [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]], six flights were sorted into two [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]], and a single flight of [[TIE/fc starfighter]]s. Unit personnel numbered forty [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], twenty-five [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] [[Technician/Legends|technicians]], twenty-five [[Controller/Legends|controllers]], and sixty support personnel.<ref name="ISB" /> Because of the compromise, the starfighters are not operated by the Imperial Navy. This also resulted in an intense rivalry between members of the ground support wing and the standard TIE pilots of the Imperial Navy.<ref name="Warfare Author's Cut 10">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-10-the-rise-of-the-empire|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 10: The Rise of the Empire}}</ref>

Although its formation was closer to a regiment, it operated under the auspices of an [[auxiliary battlegroup]].
